articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.snippet: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
articles.snippet: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.

articles.title: Elon Musk issues a warning for 'AI neoclouds' as SpaceX borrows $40 billion for chips
articles.snippet: SpaceX has raised $40 billion in debt to buy GPUs, while Musk predicts a major shakeout among smaller AI cloud providers.

articles.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

articles.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker
articles.snippet: Some of the world's biggest companies objected to being listed on the first tokenized securities trading venue under the SEC's innovation exemption. But the early pushback may say more about issuer caution than about rejection of tokenization itself.
